title: Cisco Nexus 3000 Series NX-OS Release Notes, Release 10.2(1)F
notices: Upgrading Cisco Nexus 3500 and Cisco Nexus 3600 Series Switches

observations.description: Nexus 3000: Upgrade from 6.0(2)U6(x) to 7.0(3)I7(x) causes port-channel config to be missing Symptoms: Physical members of port-channel interfaces will be missing their "channel-group...." configuration post-upgrade. Accounting log post-upgrade shows FAILURE when configuration replay is attempted by the Nexus device. Workarounds: Re-configure speed/duplex for the member interfaces and re-add channel-group config post-upgrade. Alternatively, you can upgrade to 7.0(3)I4(6) first, then jump to 7.0(3)I7(x). Issue does not seem reproduce-able then.
N36180 incorrectly reject valid 'system routing unknown-unicast-flood' cli Symptoms: Valid cli 'no system routing unknown-unicast-flood' is not accepted by parser. Workarounds: N/A
N3500 does not bring link up with Finisar transceiver after upgrade to converged code Symptoms: Link with Finisar transceiver does not come up. Workarounds: N/A
N3500 interfaces may stop processing rx traffic after connected host NIC flaps Symptoms: N3500 interface rx counters are not incrementing. Workarounds: Reload ascii of N3500.
